module.Title: Group Multiple Devices
module.Teaching: A list of dictionaries represents multiple devices that share a common structure.
module.PredictionExplanation: The outer square brackets create a list; each brace pair creates a device dictionary.
module.DebugPrompt: Use a list outside and dictionaries inside.
module.RecallPrompt: Create the two-pump list from memory. Use the exact identifier pumps. Use these exact values: 1, 2, False, "Pump 1", "Pump 2", True, "name", "running".
module.TransferPrompt: Create a list containing two fans with name and running fields. Use these exact values: 1, 2, False, "Fan 1", "Fan 2", True.
module.PreviewMessage: The facility model can now manage multiple devices.
